## File: facebookresearch_maskrcnn-benchmark/maskrcnn_benchmark/data/datasets/evaluation/voc/voc_eval.py

Prompts

```
['run PASCAL VOC evaluation on object detection predictions against ground truth boxlists', 'evaluate object detection predictions against ground truth using configurable IoU threshold and VOC metric', 'calculate precision and recall for object detection predictions using PASCAL VOC matching logic', 'calculate average precision from precision and recall arrays using 11-point or interpolated metric', 'review the PASCAL VOC evaluation functions for object detection precision recall and average precision']
```

Usage

```
{'run_voc_evaluation': 'run PASCAL VOC evaluation on object detection predictions against ground truth boxlists', 'eval_detection_voc': 'evaluate object detection predictions against ground truth using configurable IoU threshold and VOC metric', 'calc_detection_voc_prec_rec': 'calculate precision and recall for object detection predictions using PASCAL VOC matching logic', 'calc_detection_voc_ap': 'calculate average precision from precision and recall arrays using 11-point or interpolated metric', 'review_voc_eval': 'review the PASCAL VOC evaluation functions for object detection precision recall and average precision'}
```
